plan.notes: Source: SUNY Brockport official "Sample Four-Year Degree Plan: Psychology Major" page (brockport.edu). The page carries no explicit catalog year; transcribed from the current page on 2026-10-09 and filed as 2026-2027 - disclosed here. The page does not specify BA vs BS (Brockport offers both; the major core is identical). Filed as BA because the plan includes the World Languages gen-ed course, and foreign-language proficiency is the BA's distinguishing requirement per the college catalog - disclosed here; the plan works for either degree. The page marks the plan as a sample ("a student's path may differ"); transcribed exactly as published: 16+16+15+15+15+15+15+13 = 120. PSH Group I-V / Application / Integration-Capstone slots transcribed as choice slots with the plan's option lists; PSH elective slots reference the plan's Major Specific Elective Courses table (documented in the notes). Multi-credit elective rows transcribed as documented in each slot note (12 -> four 3-credit slots; 9 -> three 3-credit slots; 10 -> one 10-credit slot, not split, to avoid inventing a breakdown). Prerequisites recorded only for direct in-plan chains (PSH 202 after PSH 110; PSH 301 after PSH 110 + PSH 202; 300/400-level PSH courses after PSH 110; capstone after PSH 301). Course titles verified against the plan page. Total Credits Needed note: 9 PSH elective credits (12 if a non-PSH statistics course is taken instead of PSH 202) - documented here.
